info.name: api.getaced.io
info.description:
Base URL: https://api.getaced.io/v1

All protected routes need: Authorization: Bearer <token>

Flow: Sign in → Exchange Code → Checkout (starts trial) → Link Drive → Chrome Setup → Complete Onboarding → Set Watch Folder → Drop files

Trials handled by Creem. 30 uses/month. Supported files: PNG, HTML.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Two-step auth flow:
1. Open Google Sign In URL in browser
2. After redirect, grab the `code` from the URL and exchange it for a JWT via POST /auth/exchange

request.description:
Redirects to Google consent screen. After login redirects to:
{FRONTEND_URL}/auth/callback?code=<auth_code>

Open in browser. Copy the `code` from the redirect URL.

The code is single-use and expires in 30 seconds. Exchange it for a JWT using POST /auth/exchange.

Exchanges a short-lived auth code for a JWT token.

The code comes from the Google Sign In redirect URL (?code=xxx). It is single-use and expires in 30 seconds.

Response:
{
  "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs..."
}

Set the token as the jwt_token collection variable.

item.name: Payment (Step 1 after Sign In)
item.description: Payment is required BEFORE onboarding. Creem handles the 1-week free trial — user enters payment info but isn't charged for 7 days.

request.description:
Creates Creem checkout for monthly plan. Creem handles 1-week free trial.

success_url must start with the configured FRONTEND_URL domain.

Response: {"checkout_url": "https://checkout.creem.io/..."}

Redirect user to checkout_url. After payment, Creem webhook updates subscription_status.

Creates Creem checkout for yearly plan.

Response: {"checkout_url": "https://checkout.creem.io/..."}

item.name: Onboarding (Step 2 — requires payment/trial)
item.description:
All onboarding endpoints require active subscription or trial (402 if not).

Steps: 1. Link Drive → 2. Chrome Setup → 3. Complete

request.description:
Returns Google Drive OAuth URL. User must be on step OnboardingStepDrive.

Requires active subscription or trial (402 if not).

Response: {"url": "https://accounts.google.com/..."}

Open URL in browser. After consent, redirects to {FRONTEND_URL}/onboarding?step=chrome

Prevents duplicate Drive accounts — if this Drive is already linked to another user, returns error.

Creates Chrome container with VNC. User must be on step OnboardingStepChrome.

Requires active subscription or trial (402 if not).

Response: {"session_url": "https://api.getaced.io/v1/s/abc123"}

Open session_url in browser/iframe. 5 min window. User signs into Google in Chrome.

Returns 500 if VNC fails to start within 15 seconds.

If container already exists (retry), it deletes the old one and creates fresh.

Full user profile.

Response:
{
  "id": 1,
  "email": "student@gmail.com",
  "name": "John Doe",
  "avatar_url": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/...",
  "onboarding_step": "complete" | "OnboardingStepDrive" | "OnboardingStepChrome",
  "subscription_status": "trialing" | "active" | "canceled" | "past_due" | "expired" | "",
  "subscription_id": "sub_xxx",
  "has_drive_connected": true,
  "watch_folder_id": "1aBcDeFg...",
  "bookmark_folder_name": "school work",
  "usage_count": 5,
  "usage_limit": 30,
  "is_trialing": false,
  "is_subscription_active": true,
  "is_active": true
}

Use onboarding_step to route user to correct page.
Use is_active to gate features.

Full flow check:
1. If subscription_status is empty → show checkout
2. If onboarding_step is OnboardingStepDrive → show Drive linking
3. If onboarding_step is OnboardingStepChrome → show Chrome setup
4. If onboarding_step is complete → show dashboard

Permanently deletes user, their Chrome container, Drive watch, and all processed files.

Response: {"message": "account deleted"}

item.name: Settings (requires payment/trial)
item.description: All require active subscription or trial (402 if not).

request.description:
Sets which Drive folder to monitor. Also registers Drive push notifications.

folder_id from: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/<THIS_PART>

Folder ID must be alphanumeric (with hyphens/underscores).

Validates folder exists.

Response: {"watch_folder_id": "..."}

400 if folder not found or Drive not connected.

item.name: Webhooks (server-to-server)
item.description: These endpoints are called by external services, not by the frontend. Documented here for reference.

request.description:
Called by Creem on payment events. Verified via HMAC-SHA256 signature.

Events handled:
- checkout.completed — activates subscription
- subscription.active / subscription.paid — marks active
- subscription.trialing — marks trialing
- subscription.canceled — marks canceled, stops Drive watch, deletes container
- subscription.past_due — marks past_due
- subscription.expired — marks expired, stops Drive watch, deletes container

Idempotent: uses Creem event ID to prevent double-processing.

Called by Google Drive when files change in a watched folder.

Validated via channel token (timing-safe comparison).

Enqueues user for debounced processing (2s delay to batch rapid changes).
